query: Broadcom dividend and share repurchase program

output.content:
**Dividend.** Broadcom’s current quarterly common dividend is **$0.65 per share**, following a **10% increase** announced with FY2025 results; on an annualized basis, that is **$2.60 per share**, assuming the rate is maintained for four quarters. [[1]] 
The latest declared payment is due **September 30, 2026** to shareholders of record on **September 21, 2026**. [[2]] 
For the first three quarters of FY2026 ended August 2, Broadcom paid **$9.281 billion** in cash dividends, including **$3.103 billion** paid on June 30 alone. [[3]] [[2]]

**Share repurchases.** In March 2026, Broadcom’s board authorized a new program to repurchase up to **$10 billion** of common stock through **December 31, 2026**. [[4]] 
The authorization permits open-market or privately negotiated purchases, but does not obligate Broadcom to buy a specified amount and can be suspended or terminated at any time. [[4]] 
During the first three quarters of FY2026, Broadcom repurchased and retired **25 million shares for $8.45 billion** under its repurchase programs, versus **16 million shares for $2.45 billion** in the comparable FY2025 period. [[3]] 
As of **August 2, 2026**, Broadcom reported **$10.1 billion** still available under authorized repurchase programs, reflecting availability across the relevant authorizations rather than solely the March 2026 $10 billion program. [[3]]

**Capital-return perspective.** In FY2026 Q1 alone, Broadcom returned **$10.9 billion** to shareholders—**$3.1 billion** in dividends and **$7.8 billion** in buybacks—demonstrating that repurchases have recently been a substantial, but discretionary, complement to its recurring dividend. [[4]]
